name: Owen Pask

poster.epithet: the one who walked from the crash
poster.hook: Nineteen. Trainee nurse. Walked eleven miles toward the only light.

flashback: Who was in the car with you when the lights went out, and why didn't they walk with you?

ifUnclaimed.npc: Owen arrives during the first scene, out of breath, with a split lip. He'll do whatever the kindest person in the room says.

story.concept: A trainee nurse who was being driven home from a night shift when the dark came. He's good in a crisis because he hasn't had time to fall apart yet.
story.look: Hospital scrubs under a borrowed parka, a lanyard with his photo on it, trainers soaked through, a split lip he keeps touching.
carrying: a pen torch with a dying battery
story.stake: There were people in the cars at the crossing. He thinks some of them might still be alive.

ties.text: She's the first adult who's told him what to do in nineteen days. He'd follow her anywhere.
He saw her at the crossing, standing by one of the cars, before she came up to the light. She told him she'd only just arrived.
